# Description: Filter value interpolations in src/lm_mcp/tools that bypass quote_filter_value on purpose.
# Description: One "module.py: expression" per line; each is an integer, boolean or constant-map value, or a value already built from quote_filter_value output.
#
# tests/test_filter_invariant.py fails on any interpolation not listed here and on any
# entry that no longer matches a hit. A raw string value never belongs here: route it
# through quote_filter_value instead (cost.py: or_values is a |-join of values that
# already went through it). Print the current hits with
# `uv run python tests/test_filter_invariant.py`.
alert_rules.py: priority_filter
alerts.py: device_id
alerts.py: end_epoch
alerts.py: SEVERITY_MAP[severity.lower()]
alerts.py: start_epoch
alerts.py: str(acked).lower()
alerts.py: str(cleared).lower()
alerts.py: str(sdted).lower()
api_tokens.py: token_id
audit.py: end_time
audit.py: start_time
audit.py: token_id
collectors.py: cid
